newsitem.title: USA: Big Foot Financial posts Q1 Oct 31 loss.
newsitem.headline: Big Foot Financial posts Q1 Oct 31 loss.

text.p: Big Foot Financial Corp said it incurred a net loss of $524,000 for the first quarter ended October 31 compared with net income of $85,000 in the year-earlier period.
The current quarterly results include a one-time after-tax charge of $617,000 resulting from the recently enacted assessment to recapitalize the avings Association Insurance Fund.

Big Foot, holding company for Fairfield Savings Bank FSB, also said Friday it completed the conversion of the bank to stock form from a mutual. A total of 2.5 million shares of the company's common stock were sold at the subscription offering price of $10 per share, raising $25 million in gross proceeds.
Its stock was to begin trading December 20 on the Nasdaq National Market System.
